entities.name: Workspace
entities.description: A top-level organization container holding projects and members.

entities.name: Project
entities.description: A container for a related set of tasks, states, and members.

provenance.notes: Plane's Project (with ProjectNetwork private/public) and Kanboard's ProjectModel are independent implementations. The states list here (private/public) is verbatim from Plane's ProjectNetwork enum.

entities.name: Task / issue
entities.description: The core unit of work, optionally nested under a parent task.

provenance.notes: Plane's Issue model and Kanboard's TaskModel are independent implementations. A task's actual lifecycle state lives on the separate `state` entity (Plane) or a simple is_active flag plus column position (Kanboard), not on this entity directly.

entities.name: State / status
entities.description: A configurable status a task can be in, grouped into a small set of lifecycle groups.

provenance.notes: Plane's State/StateGroup enum is verbatim for the states list. Leantime's statusListSeed independently implements the same grouped-status idea via a statusType of NEW/INPROGRESS/DONE, corroborating the shape (a configurable status grouped into a small lifecycle bucket set) though not the exact state names.

entities.name: Swimlane
entities.description: A horizontal grouping on a kanban board (e.g. by priority, assignee, or category) that cuts across columns.

provenance.notes: Kanboard's dedicated SwimlaneModel; not found in the cloned Plane scope (Plane's grouping is done client-side by field, not a stored swimlane entity). Single source.

entities.name: Task relation
entities.description: A typed, directional link between two tasks.

provenance.notes: The relation_type values are verbatim from Plane's IssueRelationChoices, and independently corroborated by Vikunja's RelationKind and Redmine's IssueRelation TYPE_* constants, which converge on the same blocks/relates/duplicates/precedes(+reverse pair) shape across three separately-built codebases.

entities.name: Comment
entities.description: A threaded message on a task, optionally with mentions and reactions.

provenance.notes: Plane's IssueComment/IssueMention, Kanboard's CommentModel (comment.user.mention event), and Vikunja's task_comments.go/mentions.go are three independent implementations of threaded comments with @-mentions.

entities.name: Cycle / sprint
entities.description: A fixed-duration iteration that tasks are planned into.

provenance.notes: Plane's Cycle and Leantime's Sprints are independent implementations of a fixed-duration iteration. The states list (upcoming/active/completed) is reasoned from Plane's start_date/end_date rather than a stored status column in any inspected source; the Scrum Guide (2020) is authoritative for the underlying Sprint concept (fixed timebox, starts immediately after the previous ends, cancellable) but does not use these exact state names.

entities.name: Module / epic
entities.description: A larger, cross-cycle grouping of related tasks toward a feature or epic.

provenance.notes: The states list is verbatim from Plane's Module model / ModuleStatus TextChoices. Taiga's Epic model (its own EpicStatus, ordering, color) independently corroborates a larger, cross-iteration work grouping with its own status, though not these exact state names.

entities.name: Milestone
entities.description: A target date marking a significant deliverable point in a project, with an open/locked/closed lifecycle.

provenance.notes: No dedicated 'Milestone' model exists in Plane. Leantime models a milestone as a Ticket with type='milestone' (own headline/tags/color, dedicated getAllMilestones() query). Redmine's Version (VERSION_STATUSES open/locked/closed, effective_date) and OpenProject's Version (same shape) are the source of the states list here; Redmine and OpenProject share code lineage (OpenProject forked from Redmine via ChiliProject) so they are not counted as two fully independent sources -- Leantime + Redmine/OpenProject is treated as two independently-converged implementations.

entities.name: Label
entities.description: A tag applied to tasks for categorization and filtering.

provenance.notes: Plane's Label/IssueLabel and Kanboard's TaskTagModel/category model are independent implementations.

entities.name: Attachment
entities.description: A file uploaded to a task.

provenance.notes: Plane's IssueAttachment/Asset and Kanboard's TaskFileModel are independent implementations.

entities.name: Saved view
entities.description: A saved combination of filters, sort, and grouping for a project's task list.

provenance.notes: Plane's View model persists filters/sort/grouping. Focalboard's Sharing model corroborates the related public-link-sharing idea (a board exposed via an access token) as an independent implementation, though Focalboard does not have a directly equivalent saved-filter-combination model itself.

entities.name: Time entry
entities.description: A logged block of time spent on a task by a user.

provenance.notes: Kanboard's SubtaskTimeTrackingModel (start/stop timer, computed duration) and Leantime's Timesheets (workDate/hours/description, billable 'kind', invoicedEmpl/invoicedComp) are independent implementations of a logged time entry, with genuinely different capture mechanisms (timer vs manual+billing entry).

entities.name: Estimate scale
entities.description: A project-defined scale of effort values (e.g. Fibonacci points) that tasks can be sized against.

provenance.notes: Plane's Estimate model / Issue.estimate_point FK and Leantime's Tickets.efforts (Fibonacci-like point scale) are independent implementations of a project-defined effort scale.

entities.name: Guest / external member
entities.description: A restricted, often unauthenticated or lightly-authenticated external participant with view/comment access to a specific project.

provenance.notes: Plane's ProjectPublicMember and ProjectDeployBoard models; single source.
